highlights: Shocking Bass: Thanks to Baseus's low-frequency enhancement technology, the bass response is dramatically enhanced, restoring true sound and creating an immersive on-site experience.

40mm PET Speakers: Our earphones are distinguished by the built-in 40mm sized full-range large speakers, providing the ability to analyse all kinds of musical instruments and the direction of their sound, precisely rendering music details and bring the sounds to life.

65H Playback: When fully charged and set at 70% volume, these headphones offer up to 65 hours of playtime. This allows it to easily meet the needs of long distance and lengthy time away from the charging cable, liberating you from concerns over battery life.

Soft Sponge Earmuffs: With a 3D wrap-around ear design that fits snugly against the ear, these soft, pressure-free ear muffs ensure comfort during wear while also providing a tranquil, immersive music experience.
Foldable Design: Perfect for the outdoors, the headphones conveniently fold down, making them easy to carry on any adventure.
